profile_text.body:
Cadence Design Systems is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, traded under the ticker CDNS and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000813672. On its own site the company describes itself as a leading EDA and Intelligent System Design provider that delivers hardware, software, and IP for electronic design. The same site text also describes the company's culture, cites Fortune's 100 Great Places to Work, and points to its investment in sustainability.

The harvested site material does not name specific AI products or platforms, so there is no product-level detail to report beyond the hardware, software, and IP offering described above. The company's stated position is that of an electronic design automation and intelligent system design provider.

The litigation record associated with the company sits in California, with a count of 281. No individual cases are listed in the record, and no MCP servers are recorded for the company.
